messages.text:
Hi Support,

Just checking to see when my miner duster will ship?

And since the overclock kit has not shipped, can you please cancel it?  It's kinda dumb to include a 350W PS for 'overclocking' when the BS-4 comes with one already.

Thank you,
Scott
Handed to the team · Line refund needs a supervisor decision; held so it does not ship meanwhile.

Hi Scott,

Your Miner Duster isn't at our warehouse yet. It's on pre-order and ships by December 7. Once it leaves, the tracking will come to you by email. You can follow that stock on its way to our warehouse at https://heliumdeploy.com/pages/shipment-status

About the Overclocking kit: it hasn't shipped, and I've put a stop on it so it won't go out. The kit was sold as a final sale item, so cancelling it isn't something we normally do. Your point is a fair one, though, since the BS-4 already comes with its own power supply. I've sent your request to a supervisor to review. A colleague will pick it up when the team is back on Monday, and the answer will come to you in this email thread.

Your Duster stays on the order, and nothing changes for it.

Best,
Sarah
